name: Vantage Corp Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Established in Singapore in 2012, Vantage Corp delivers specialized shipbroking, operational support, and strategic consultancy services tailored for the oil tanker industry. Operating from key hubs in Singapore and Dubai, the company caters to a diverse client base, including oil companies, traders, shipowners, and commercial managers. Their extensive offerings encompass identifying lucrative market opportunities and providing critical intelligence, facilitating connections between shipowners and cargo owners, and offering expert advice on vessel deployment strategies, fleet composition, and technical specifications. Vantage Corp also plays a pivotal role in mediating contract negotiations, ensuring seamless logistical execution, and resolving any disputes that may arise throughout the term of chartering agreements.
